request.description:
Create a one-time token that allows to access to the account by opening the link provided.
It lasts only 1 hour and any attempting to use this token after 1 hour will result in a 401 Unauthorized response.
By providing the bool value, you can set or unset the suspension status for a user.

request.description: Return a single zone by its ID, if available to the authenticated user.

It has an acknowledgement of the creation of the zone. If set to true, the zone will be created even if it is
over the limits of the account and the subscription will be updated as well. Be aware with it, because you
might update your subscription.
<aside class="notice">This endpoint might affect your subscription according to the parameters provided.</aside>
Only values provided in the request will be updated.
This won't affect your subscription.
By providing the bool value, you can set or unset the suspension status for a zone.

request.description:
It will update the zones provided in the request. It might involve 1 up to 100 zones at a time.
<aside class="notice">Be aware that if the zones are not accessible to the authenticated user or if any of the zone IDs are not valid
it will return an error.</aside>
